result.summary: The image shows a residential row-house street with continuous sidewalks but a complete lack of dedicated pedestrian safety infrastructure. There are no marked crosswalks, traffic signals, or traffic calming measures visible, and sightlines are partially obstructed by parked vehicles.

hazards.name: Parked vehicle sightline obstruction
hazards.description: Continuous parking along the curb limits visibility between drivers and pedestrians attempting to cross the street.
hazards.location_in_image: Along both sides of the roadway

hazards.name: Surface debris and tripping hazards
hazards.description: Trash, loose items, and uneven pavement patches are present on both the sidewalk and the roadway.

interventions.description: Install continental-style marked crosswalks at intersections to clearly define pedestrian space.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions

interventions.title: Street Trees

result.summary: The pedestrian environment is characterized by a complete lack of crossing infrastructure at a residential intersection. While sidewalks are present, they lack curb ramps, and the roadway surface is significantly degraded with no marked crosswalks or traffic controls.

hazards.name: Lack of marked crosswalks
hazards.description: No designated area for pedestrians to cross the intersection, increasing risk of conflict with vehicles.

hazards.name: Poor pavement condition
hazards.description: Uneven and patched roadway surface can cause tripping or affect vehicle handling.

hazards.name: Lack of curb ramps
hazards.description: No sloped transitions at the corner, making the crossing inaccessible for people with mobility aids or strollers.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install zebra-style markings to clearly define pedestrian right-of-way.

interventions.title: ADA Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Install detectable warning surfaces and sloped ramps at all corners.

interventions.title: Pavement Rehabilitation
interventions.description: Resurface the roadway to provide a smooth, predictable surface for all users.
